purpose: Synthetic measurement-math check only; no PREM model or wavefield solve is run.

receiver_selection.basis: ObsPy TauP PREM ray predictions used only to select a candidate receiver/window placement; this is not a computed wavefield.

synthetic_probe.operator: Production SPARSESPEC::WindowedDisplacementMap from the absolute DSpecM1D production header path.
synthetic_probe.band_weights: Apply to raw solver-frequency bins before inverse transform: 1 below 8 mHz; 0.5*(1+cos(pi*(f_mHz-8)/2)) for 8<=f<10 mHz; 0 at and above 10 mHz.
synthetic_probe.time_window: sqrt(0.5*(1-cos(2*pi*(t-1000)/200))) for 1000<=t<=1200 s, zero otherwise; applied after damping removal by the production map.
synthetic_probe.synthetic_signal: Two deterministic real Gaussian-windowed sinusoidal time signals (3.4 and 4.1 mHz), exponentially damped with FreqFull ep before conversion to raw RFFT spectra.
synthetic_probe.gradient: Freeze q=df*eta*p at baseline p=P(BU); raw gradient is B*P.adjoint(q), checked against central differences in the real-spectrum subspace.
synthetic_probe.linear_engine_convention: Existing qdotp objective with weights q and output p is 2E; this probe reports the distinction explicitly.
synthetic_probe.frequency_bin_policy_open_item: FreqFull::i1 skips DC (minimum bin 1) and i2 is an exclusive upper bound with a bracket bin above fmax. The synthetic map/energy checks exercise real DC and Nyquist endpoints. Resolve how solver-skipped DC and the bracket bin interact with this observable before making physical-kernel claims.
synthetic_probe.execution_boundary: Compile the probe only in this phase. Parent owns numerical execution. No Earth/kernel solver run, no degree/convergence campaign.
